question: What is the true cause of twice-born status in the consecration of awareness?
premises: In the consecration of awareness within the twice-born state, birth-womb is not the cause.
The analogy of silver and other metals continues the refining image.
One who is peace-natured is called twice-born.
inference: Twice-born status in this context depends on consecrated awareness and peaceful nature, not on physical birth.
plain_english: Likewise, as with silver and the rest, in the consecration of awareness within the twice-born state the womb is not the cause; there, one who is of peaceful nature is called twice-born.
